commitResults.messageTitle: feat: add automatic file persistence and storage loading (Level-7, Save)
commitResults.messageBody:
- Implement Storage class with OS-independent relative paths for saving and loading tasks.

- Add polymorphic toFileFormat() methods to Task, Todo, Deadline, and Event.

- Automatically persist task list changes to disk upon add, mark, unmark, and delete.

- Support cold start with non-existent data directory/file and graceful recovery from corrupted records.

- Add data/ to .gitignore and enhance UI test isolation.

commitResults.messageTitle: feat: add date and time parsing and date query command (Level-8, Dates and Times)
commitResults.messageBody:
- Implement DateTimeUtil with multi-format parsing (ISO, slash formats, 24-hour time) and formatted display.

- Upgrade Deadline and Event to store structured TaskDateTime objects.

- Validate that event end times do not precede start times.

- Add 'date' command to query deadlines and events occurring on a specified date.

- Update UI test suite to verify date-time parsing, formatting, and date filtering.

commitResults.messageTitle: refactor: extract Ui class for user interaction and persona dialogue
commitResults.messageBody:
- Extract Ui class to encapsulate console I/O, banner rendering, broadcast dividers, task feedback messages, and persona dialogue remarks.
- Refactor Braun to an instance-based coordinator delegating all display and input reading to Ui.
- Isolate presentation logic from control flow to uphold the Single Responsibility Principle as part of A-MoreOOP.

commitResults.messageTitle: refactor: organize codebase into domain packages (A-Packages)
commitResults.messageBody:

- Add package declarations and explicit import statements across layers to enforce encapsulation.
- Update test-ui runner script to discover nested Java source files recursively and invoke braun.Braun.
- Maintain src/main/java as the primary source root for CS2103T standards.

commitResults.messageTitle: Format code to comply with SE-EDU coding standard
commitResults.messageBody:
Several lines across the codebase exceed the 120-character maximum line
length limit, and some Javadoc tag descriptions lack terminal
punctuation.

The project requires adherence to the SE-EDU Java Coding Standard
(Basic + Intermediate rules) to maintain high code readability,
consistent layout, and clean documentation generation.

Let's,
* wrap lines exceeding 120 characters with 8-space continuation indents
* add terminal punctuation to all @param, @return, and @throws tags
* format long boolean conditional expressions and constructor
  signatures across Braun, Ui, Storage, DateTimeUtil, and Task classes

Following these layout rules ensures compliance with the course coding
standard and keeps source files clean and readable.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add seedu-java-coding-standard skill
commitResults.messageBody:
The project needs a formalized definition of the SE-EDU Java Coding
Standard so coding style rules can be referenced consistently.

Creating a dedicated skill enables autonomous agents and developers to
verify Java conventions against a standardized specification.

Let's add the seedu-java-coding-standard skill detailing naming,
layout, statement, and Javadoc rules from SE-EDU conventions.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add seedu-git-standard skill
commitResults.messageBody:
The project needs a clear standard for Git commit messages and branch
naming conventions based on course guidelines.

Establishing this skill ensures all future commits adhere to the
SE-EDU Git conventions consistently.

Let's add the seedu-git-standard skill specifying subject line format,
imperative mood, 72-character body wrapping, and commit structure.

commitResults.messageTitle: Update AGENTS.md to mandate SE-EDU standards
commitResults.messageBody:
Agent guidelines do not currently enforce the SE-EDU Java coding
standard or Git commit conventions.

Explicit instructions in the agent prompt ensure that future code
modifications and commits automatically adhere to both standards.

Let's update AGENTS.md to mandate compliance with the
seedu-java-coding-standard and seedu-git-standard skills.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add find command to search tasks by keyword
commitResults.messageBody:
Users currently have no way to search for specific tasks without
scrolling through the entire list of tasks.

Providing a search facility allows users to quickly locate relevant
tasks by querying a keyword or phrase against task descriptions.

Let's,
* add handleFind to Braun to filter tasks matching the given keyword
* add showMatchingTasks to Ui to display matching tasks or feedback
* update unknown command guidance to include the find command
* add JUnit unit tests in UiTest covering matching and empty results
* expand ui-test-plan.md with 4 automated test cases for find

Case-insensitive substring matching is used so users can find tasks
without needing to recall the exact letter casing.
